Item.Description: CLEAR - Cargo is free of any impediments and may be released.
CONDCLEAR - Cargo can be released into home consumption subject to condition(s) These conditions are provided in Supplementary Information.
CLEARHRM - Cargo is Clear but is identified as High Risk Movement
DCLALLOWED - Cargo may be deconsolidated. This status value only applies to Air Cargo.
SUBUBMOV - Cargo cannot be released into home consumption but underbond movement is allowed
TRANSHIP - Cargo is for transhipment. A transhipment Number will be generated and transmitted with Status
TRANSIT - Cargo is transit cargo. This value will only be viewable from an interactive function.
TRANSHPHRM - Transhipment Cargo is Clear but is identified as High Risk Movement
HELD - Cargo is held under Customs control
ACSSEIZED - Cargo is seized by Customs
AQISSEIZED - Cargo is seized by Quarantine
WITHDRAWN - Cargo Report had been withdrawn
